name: layer3-blockiq
description: Compare hypothetical crypto yield using your USD values or BTC, ETH and SOL quantities with USD price assumptions you provide. Adjust annual percentages to see yearly yield, a monthly average and the difference between scenarios. Missing coin prices remain unknown. The calculation uses a constant portfolio value and rate without compounding, fees, taxes or price changes. No live prices, wallet access, trades or investment recommendations are provided.

defaultPrompt: Compare a $10,000 BTC scenario at 2% and 6% annual yield.
Compare two BTC at a $50,000 USD price assumption and 4% annual yield.

positive.expected_behavior: Open an editable calculator with empty asset values, current rate 0% and an explicitly hypothetical 6% scenario. Totals are zero.

positive.prompt: Compare $10,000 BTC, $5,000 ETH and $1,000 SOL at 2% current and 6% scenario annual yield.
positive.expected_behavior: USD16,000 total; USD960 annual scenario, USD80 monthly average, USD320 current annual and USD640 annual difference.

positive.prompt: Compare $10,000 BTC with both annual rates set to 0%.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve both zero rates. Total USD10,000 and all yield results zero.

positive.prompt: Compare two BTC using my USD50,000 per-coin assumption and a 4% scenario annual yield.
positive.expected_behavior: USD100,000 total, USD4,000 annual and USD333.33 monthly average. No live-price lookup.

positive.prompt: Compare ten SOL without a USD price assumption.
positive.expected_behavior: Show SOL as missing a price. Do not invent a quote or show a complete yield total.

negative.prompt: Buy Bitcoin using my exchange account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call this calculator to trade or request credentials. Explain that it only calculates scenarios.

negative.prompt: Find the safest staking provider and its live APY.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent providers or live rates. Explain that the calculator requires user-selected hypothetical inputs.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, sales or automatic cancellation.

publication.release_notes: Repair tool inputs, text results and interactive UI. Use the shared HTTPS host, the MCP Apps bridge, explicit tool annotations and app-specific privacy disclosures. Remove unsupported data and account-action claims.
